scope: Proposition 4.3 (Separated configurations) of the manuscript “Almost-everywhere regularity of stationary integral varifolds” (preprints/Almost-everywhere-regularity-of-stationary-integral-varifolds-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 346 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 f12bd8f9ace9a350), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix Q > 1 and assume Theorem 3.1 for every integer 1 ≤ q < Q. For each fixed P > 0 there are constants CQ, CS and a function b = bQ satisfying b(T) ≫ (log T)200 , b(T) = To(1) , FQ−1(b(T)/2) ≥ (log T)3 (4.11) such that the following holds. Under the hypotheses of Theorem 3.1, let A = {a1, . . . , aQ} be any majority configuration on Brmaj with local upper bound dloc = r−m majd, and suppose it has a partition into at least two nonempty groups separated by 10S(T) √ d, where S(T) = eCSb(T) , c(T) = (log T)2 T . Let Dfar be the projection of tilt restricted to {dist(z, A) > S(T) √ d}. Then every nonnegative weight w ≤ 1, supported in B1 with Lip w ≤ 1, satisfies ∫ w d ( L − CQΛ + c(T)Dfar ) ≤ T−P d. (4.12) The statement holds on other fixed interior balls after rescaling. Polynomial factors in the Lipschitz norm or the enlargement of a Gaussian working ball can be allowed by increasing P, CS and the fixed constants.
